name: White Seahorse 98
author: Praashoo7
description: 3d pill gray checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
On hover, box-shadow becomes inset 17px 17px 16px #b3b3b3,
            inset -17px -17px 16px #ffffff, box-shadow becomes 3px 3px 3px #000000. Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes none, background-color changes from #ccc to limegreen, transform becomes rotateX(360deg).
